integrity: Deterministic independent boundary-value checks available as verify.py; actual infinite-time conclusions rely on analytical CBF and Tauberian arguments, not finite experiments. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional translationally invariant two-state telegraph motion, D>0 and alpha>0; fixed-positive-v tail is not uniform as v tends to zero; claim concerns expected painted volume only. Full original transform and passive endpoint formula already in Sezik et al.; independent publication-priority assessment pending.
title: Positive polar-paint accumulation and an algebraic active tail
